supporting_observations.claim: WS-TWEBER-01 (10.51.10.22) made repeated TCP connections to 10.51.20.30:8080 at approximately five-minute intervals from 13:36 to 14:06 UTC. The records describe these connections as HTTP to the internal proxy, not as direct HTTPS connections to an identified external destination.
The repeated proxy connections have broadly similar recorded byte counts, but the connection records do not identify the requested host or establish whether the proxy carried HTTPS traffic.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied sensor status reports that proxy logs for PROXY-PIN-01 were not collected during the review window, preventing confirmation of proxy request destinations or CONNECT details.
The supplied sensor status reports that winsec and sysmon logs for WS-TWEBER-01 were not collected during the review window, limiting attribution of the connections to a process or user.
Zeek connection, DNS, and TLS sensors are reported as available, but the supplied records do not identify an external destination for the repeated connections.
claims_not_established: The available records do not establish that the repeated proxy sessions were HTTPS or identify the external service they accessed.
The available records do not establish which process or user on WS-TWEBER-01 initiated the sessions.
The evidence does not establish whether the sessions were the approved MediLedger update checks or malicious activity.
The supplied records do not establish what data, if any, was exchanged with an external service.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain proxy access logs for the review window, including CONNECT targets, requested hostnames, outcomes, and any user or client attribution.
Obtain endpoint process and network telemetry for WS-TWEBER-01 covering the review window, including process-to-connection attribution.
Check MediLedger installation, updater logs, and configuration on WS-TWEBER-01 to determine whether it generated the repeated sessions and whether the destination matches the approved update service.
unrelated_findings: Other workstations made TLS connections to WS-TWEBER-01 on port 443; these are inbound to WS-TWEBER-01 and do not establish the alerted outbound activity. Review separately if needed (T075-00037, T075-00038, T075-00039, T075-00072, T075-00073, T075-00074, T075-00185, T075-00186, T075-00187, T075-00199, T075-00200, T075-00201).
PROXY-PIN-01 initiated a connection to WS-TWEBER-01 on port 135; this is separate from the alerted outbound sessions and may warrant a separate review (T075-00195, T075-00198).
